dsh-github-skills 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

posts.en:
dsh-github-skills is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dab1edbe59d2546f3fe0.html
